title: Pelagonius, Ars veterinaria (Veterinary Medicine) / RU: Пелагоний, «Ветеринарное искусство»
author: Pelagonius, writing to named horse-owners
genre: Veterinary manual on horses, in letter form
edition: Fischer, Teubner 1980 (in copyright). Ihm 1892, public domain: https://archive.org/details/pelagoniiartiav00pelagoog
ru_evidence: Not in the ancientrome, vostlit or simposium catalogues. No Russian translation found.
en_evidence: en.wikipedia lists only the Fischer edition. Open Library shows Italian (2014) and French (2019) versions only; Adams 1995 is a linguistic study.
other_translations: Italian: Arte veterinaria (Società Dante Alighieri 2014). French: Recueil de médecine vétérinaire (Budé 2019). Italian translation of 1826.
value: The best-preserved Latin veterinary treatise. Evidence for aristocratic and circus horse culture, close parallels to the Greek hippiatric corpus, letters naming real addressees; a key source for the Latin technical vocabulary (Adams 1995).
ai_feasibility: medium: formulaic recipes. Disease and drug terms need checking against the Greek hippiatric texts and Adams' lexicon.
pilot_unit: Preface and opening chapters on fever and head ailments (est. 5–6k words)
